description: This file contains a PHP class `TCPDFBarcode` that provides methods to generate array representations of various 1D barcode types for use with the TCPDF library. It includes barcode encoding algorithms, checksum calculations, and conversion functions, supporting multiple barcode standards like Code 39, Code 93, Code 128, EAN, UPC, and others.

classes.name: TCPDFBarcode
classes.description: A PHP class for creating array representations of common 1D barcodes to be used with TCPDF, providing barcode encoding, checksum, and conversion methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the barcode object with a specific code and type, generating the barcode array.

methods.name: getBarcodeArray
methods.description: Returns the array representation of the barcode generated.

methods.name: setBarcode
methods.description: Main method that sets the barcode array based on given code and type, selecting the appropriate encoding method.

methods.name: barcode_code39
methods.description: Generates a barcode array for Code 39 encoding, with options for extended characters and checksum.

methods.name: encode_code39_ext
methods.description: Encodes a string into the Code 39 extended character set.

methods.name: checksum_code39
methods.description: Calculates the checksum for Code 39 barcode data.

methods.name: barcode_code93
methods.description: Generates a barcode array for Code 93 encoding, including checksum calculation.

methods.name: checksum_code93
methods.description: Computes the checksum for Code 93 barcodes.

methods.name: barcode_s25
methods.description: Encodes data into Standard 2 of 5 barcode symbology, optionally with checksum.

methods.name: barcode_i25
methods.description: Encodes data into Interleaved 2 of 5 barcode symbology, optionally with checksum.

methods.name: barcode_msi
methods.description: Encodes data into MSI barcode symbology, with optional checksum.

methods.name: barcode_c128
methods.description: Encodes data into Code 128 barcode symbology of types A, B, or C.

methods.name: barcode_eanupc
methods.description: Encodes data into EAN and UPC barcode symbologies.

methods.name: barcode_postnet
methods.description: Generates Postnet or Planet barcode representation for postal codes.

methods.name: barcode_codabar
methods.description: Generates Codabar barcode array.

methods.name: barcode_code11
methods.description: Encodes data into Code 11 barcode.

methods.name: barcode_pharmacode
methods.description: Encodes digits into Pharmacode barcode.

methods.name: barcode_pharmacode2t
methods.description: Encodes digits into Pharmacode Two-Track barcode.

methods.name: binseq_to_array
methods.description: Converts a binary sequence string into barcode bar and space array.

methods.name: dec_to_hex
methods.description: Converts large integers (string format) to hexadecimal string (needs bc math extension).

methods.name: hex_to_dec
methods.description: Converts hexadecimal string to decimal (string) using bc math extension.

methods.name: imb_crc11fcs
methods.description: Calculates the Frame Check Sequence (FCS) for Intelligent Mail barcode.

methods.name: imb_reverse_us
methods.description: Reverses the bits in an unsigned short number.

methods.name: imb_tables
methods.description: Generates lookup tables for the Intelligent Mail Barcode.
